quote.1:
Land est exactement ce dont VS Code avait besoin — une alternative performante et ouverte.
C'est incroyablement rapide.
quote.2:
L'architecture Effect-TS est magnifique.
La securite de type detecte les bugs avant qu'ils ne surviennent.
quote.3:
Executer mes extensions existantes sans modification est revolutionnaire.
La compatibilite est impressionnante.
quote.4:
Enfin, un editeur qui respecte mes ressources systeme.
Fini la surconsommation memoire d'Electron.
quote.5:
L'engagement open source signifie que je peux contribuer et personnaliser.
C'est l'editeur que j'attendais.
quote.6:
L'architecture basee sur gRPC est un chef-d'oeuvre de conception systeme.
Land est l'avenir des editeurs de bureau.

architecture.title: [FR] Architecture
architecture.subtitle: [FR] Land replaces VS Code's Electron stack with a modular, high-performance architecture. Each element is a standalone repository.

mountain.description: [FR] Manages Window, File System, and Process lifecycle. The native Rust/Tauri backend that replaces Electron's main process.
mountain.subtitle: [FR] Rust/Tauri native backend

cocoon.description: [FR] Runs VS Code extensions via Effect-TS with high-fidelity API compatibility. No changes needed to existing extensions.
cocoon.subtitle: [FR] TypeScript extension host

wind.description: [FR] Re-implementation of the VS Code Workbench. Provides the editor shell, panels, sidebars, and activity bar.
wind.subtitle: [FR] TypeScript UI service

sky.description: [FR] Renders the editor interface using Astro components. Handles themes, layouts, and the visual presentation layer.
sky.subtitle: [FR] Astro UI component

air.description: [FR] Background daemon for automatic updates, downloads, and cryptographic signing. Keeps Land up to date silently.
air.subtitle: [FR] Rust background daemon

echo.description: [FR] High-performance work-stealing executor. Schedules and distributes tasks across cores for maximum throughput.
echo.subtitle: [FR] Rust task scheduler
